edits.reason: Swift prespecialized metadata stays on in every process although files override cache images (OCLP's Metal and Wi-Fi libraries, this recipe's CoreWiFi compat library, Apple's libsystem_kernel/platform/pthread): the two reads of _dyld_shared_cache_some_image_overridden() in libswiftCore answer false, and the descriptor-map slots of the overridden images are emptied so their names take the runtime's ordinary path (src/prespecialization.py; install.py refuses an image whose overridden set differs)
The x86_64 kernel registers only 4 KiB code-signature pages for the cache; RosettaOS signs it with 16 KiB pages for Apple silicon, so the signature is made again with 4 KiB pages after the edits
